new_src='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background, divider = [v for v, _ in counts.most_common(2)]
    markers = set(counts) - {background, divider}

    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if all(v != background for v in grid[r])]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(h))]
    marker_rows = [r for r in row_lines if any(grid[r][c] in markers for c in col_lines)]
    marker_cols = [c for c in col_lines if any(grid[r][c] in markers for r in row_lines)]
    if len(marker_rows) < 2 or len(marker_cols) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    row_lines = [r for r in row_lines if marker_rows[0] <= r <= marker_rows[-1]]
    col_lines = [c for c in col_lines if marker_cols[0] <= c <= marker_cols[-1]]

    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(row_lines, row_lines[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(col_lines, col_lines[1:]):
            corners = (grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1])
            row.append(corners[0] if corners[0] in markers and len(set(corners)) == 1 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''

new_src='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    candidates = [v for v, _ in counts.most_common(2)]
    line_counts = {v: sum(all(x != v for x in row) for row in grid) +
                      sum(all(grid[r][c] != v for r in range(h)) for c in range(w))
                   for v in candidates}
    background = max(candidates, key=lambda v: line_counts[v])
    divider = next(v for v in candidates if v != background)
    markers = set(counts) - {background, divider}

    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if all(v != background for v in grid[r])]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(h))]
    marker_rows = [r for r in row_lines if any(grid[r][c] in markers for c in col_lines)]
    marker_cols = [c for c in col_lines if any(grid[r][c] in markers for r in row_lines)]
    if len(marker_rows) < 2 or len(marker_cols) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    row_lines = [r for r in row_lines if marker_rows[0] <= r <= marker_rows[-1]]
    col_lines = [c for c in col_lines if marker_cols[0] <= c <= marker_cols[-1]]

    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(row_lines, row_lines[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(col_lines, col_lines[1:]):
            corners = (grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1])
            row.append(corners[0] if corners[0] in markers and len(set(corners)) == 1 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
